## Task list {#task-list}


### [F01 - fuel-component separation and model exploration](task-f01.qmd) {#f01}

**Status: Completed - analytical record.**

The [component definitions](task-f01.qmd#tbl-fuel-component-dictionary) separate vegetation components and pre-PCT litter/duff, omitting post-PCT forest-floor estimates. The [executable analytical sequence](task-f01.qmd#publication-execution) integrates derivation, exploration, candidate-fitting code, and complete CSV evidence; shared helpers are defined inline and saved for later tasks. The [model-review register](task-f01.qmd#rendered-provisional-model-review-register) reports provisional AIC leaders, not final selections. Prediction, inference, and display decisions belong to [RD04](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review); the task pages own calculation order and selective recomputation. Runs solely in the locked publication environment from committed thesis exports; current outputs and in-stage computational checks define the workflow. Quarto can recompute this whole task independently or render its saved evidence.


### [RD04 - fuel phase and PCT display](task-rd04.qmd) {#rd04}

**Status: Figure complete; publication table accepted.**

The [nine-panel inventory](task-rd04.qmd#completed-output) reports phase-specific mean fuel loads and a matched woody contrast. The [inference review](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review) distinguishes model changes, random-effect integration, and unmatched thesis component definitions. The [accepted supplementary table](task-rd04.qmd#fuel-companion-table) presents all 60 estimates from the canonical CSV. Woody change uses the joint phase model and its pre/post covariance. Saved computational checks support the implementation; model adequacy and the RT03 narrative remain under review. F01 supplies the provisional fitted models. RD04 can render saved results or recompute from those fits in the locked publication environment.


### [RD02 - regeneration basal area display](task-rd02.qmd) {#rd02}

**Status: Completed - redwood treatment-dependent zeros and publication displays accepted.**

RD02 is complete. The [selected models](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-selected-models) retain four separate hurdle-Gamma fits with treatment and site/macro-plot intercepts in the positive component. Redwood now includes treatment in its zero component; the other categories retain constant zero probabilities. The [zero-process review](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-zero-sensitivity) documents the occurrence rationale and modest AIC advantage (0.85) over the redwood constant-zero baseline. Updated integrated means, full-covariance delta intervals, RW/TO Results figure, and four-category supplement table are accepted. Earlier [constant-zero covariance comparisons](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-04) remain distinct from the final selection. Four-site uncertainty, boundary variances, model-selection uncertainty, and unassessed bootstrap coverage remain limitations; formal pairwise treatment contrasts have not been performed.


### [RD03 - sprout-height display](task-rd03.qmd) {#rd03}

**Status: In progress - Phase One audit complete; human review pending.**

The [Phase One audit](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-phase-one) reconciles all 692 workbook clumps with the saved analysis, verifies the interval definitions, and exports typed measurements and historical references. It recovers redwood residual-tree codes (197 code 0, 137 code 1), identifies the separate tallest-ten subset, and reports equal-site descriptive means. Original enrollment, mortality, leader identity, sampling probabilities, and residual-code timing remain unresolved. The [human review and Phase Two handoff](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-handoff) preserves the selected recorded-cohort target and directs reference/design/covariance fitting after review; no publication model or display is accepted.


### [RT01 - regeneration Results narrative](task-rt01.qmd) {#rt01}

**Status: Queued - ready after completed RD02.**

RD02 is complete with treatment-dependent redwood zero probabilities and constant zeros for the other species categories. Draft a 1–2-page regeneration Results subsection from the updated accepted display and canonical estimates, emphasizing redwood with concise tanoak context and supplemental treatment of other species. Report population-average means and approximate confidence intervals without implying that formal pairwise contrasts have been performed. Every quantitative claim must be traceable to an accepted display or linked table.
